    Semicontinuity of kernel dimension in a polynomial family #

    For a family of linear maps T s = ∑ m < N, s ^ m • Q m, the kernel dimension at all but finitely many parameters is at most its value at one parameter (finite_lt_finrank_ker). A nonvanishing minor at the given parameter is a nonzero polynomial in s.
